name: Minimal Nordic
description: A compact low-ornament compass card with a restrained teal wind spear.
notes: All layers use a centered 512 x 512 RGBA canvas. This fallback favors silhouette and cardinal readability over surface detail.

orientationConventions.ring: North is at 12 o'clock in the source texture. Apply heading only to the rose transform.
orientationConventions.windPointer: The teal spear tip points to 12 o'clock at world bearing 0. Its circular pivot is centered at (0.5, 0.5); mount it on the rose and apply pure world bearing.
orientationConventions.lubberMarker: Static screen-space layer. The downward point is baked at 12 o'clock and marks the player's facing.
